summary: Atari Games' 1987 armed-driving arcade game about surviving 50 fuel-limited rallies, later converted to home computers, consoles, and arcade compilations.

entries.title: RoadBlasters

emulation.notes: Use arcade emulation for the primary route; Lynx and Genesis ports are historical alternatives only.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Arcade-accurate emulation with modern display scaling

primary.why: RoadBlasters was developed for Atari System 1 arcade hardware and later ported to home computers, NES, Lynx, and Genesis/Mega Drive. The arcade version is the original, highest-authenticity route; later ports and compilations do not add sourced exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the arcade version in MAME or on original hardware; Midway Arcade Treasures on sixth-generation consoles/Windows is a convenient compilation route if owned.

entries.remaster_caveats: Later compilations are access routes for the arcade game, not remasters with new content.
